in_sanskrit.name: Rīteṣa
in_sanskrit.meaning: One who has Ri (sun) as his deity
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: The name 'Rīteṣa' is derived from the Sanskrit words 'Rīt' (sun) and 'Iṣa' (Lord). It is a name for someone who has the sun as his deity. This name is not commonly used in Hinduism but it is a valid and meaningful name.

in_hindi.name: रीतेश
in_hindi.meaning: सूर्य देव का पुत्रा या प्रेमिका
in_hindi.long_meaning: The name 'Reetesh' in Hindi can be translated to 'Son of Surya (Sun God)' or 'Beloved of Surya (Sun God)'. This name is not commonly used in Hinduism but it is a valid and meaningful name.

in_tamil.long_meaning: The name 'Reetesh' in Tamil can be translated to 'Son of God' or 'Daughters of God'. This name is not commonly used in Hinduism but it is a valid and meaningful name.

in_telugu.name: రీధేశ

in_marathi.name: Reetesh
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Path of the Sun
in_marathi.long_meaning: Reetesh हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। The name Reetesh is derived from the Sanskrit word 'Ritam' which means 'path'. The suffix 'esh' is added to indicate 'belonging to' or 'related to'. So, the name Reetesh can be interpreted as 'the one who belongs to or follows the path of the Sun'.
